narrative.intro: National Steel and Shipbuilding shows $2.8B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. National Steel and Shipbuilding received 16 awards this period, with an average award size of $173M, and obligations are up 403.1% year over year. National Steel and Shipbuilding has a multi-year pattern of award activity: FY21 obligations were $471M, FY22 obligations were $2.2B, FY23 obligations were $1.2B, FY24 obligations were $1.4B, and FY25 obligations were $550M. National Steel and Shipbuilding current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date, and reported figures reflect contract obligations except where award-value figures are separately noted. National Steel and Shipbuilding activity shows variability across years, with FY22 and FY26 at the highest reported levels. National Steel and Shipbuilding average award size and total obligations together describe how concentrated recent federal revenue is, given the 16 awards recorded in FY2026 to date. National Steel and Shipbuilding can be compared to peers using the year-by-year obligations and the reported year-over-year change.
